All classes are in the Java package com.studyagent; the boxes above group them by layer, as in Stage 1.
Patterns: MVC (MainGUI / CLIView -> StudyController -> StudyService), Builder (Prompt::PromptBuilder),
New since Stage 1: StudyService, KnowledgeRepository, SummarizationService, RecommendationService,
Removed since Stage 1: View, CourseController, CourseService, StudyRepository, ResultRepository,
ProgressAnalyzer, QuizGrader, ResponseParser, AnswerEvaluation, StudyAgentApp, Course, Material,
Concept, StudySession, Question, QuestionResult, LearningSession, Difficulty, QuizType, QuestionType, GradingStatus.
Renamed / reshaped: CLI -> CLIView; PromptBuilder -> nested Prompt::PromptBuilder; QuizResult -> ProgressRepository::QuizResult;
LearningSession -> ConversationMemory::Exchange; QuizGrader.grade -> Quiz.grade; ProgressAnalyzer -> RecommendationService.
